name: ui
title: UI
owns: The Hive UI: the Fleet overview, Pool and The Swarm; the session dock and the optional reader; the on-demand task, Harvest, Shadow, History and Scheduled views and the Review artifact surface; artifact serving; decision cards over scoped projections; every file of a review directory, which every package of the same home reads through the contract library.

commands.name: hive-ui
commands.purpose: Serving the UI and review artifacts, the scoped feedback writer and the review files.

test_scope: Projection coverage and freshness, stale and incomplete cards, revision-bound submissions, same-session continuity, durable review rounds, receipt-driven motion, reconnect, reduced motion, context restoration, receipt display, and scheduled-job and temporary-rule lists read from records with incomplete coverage shown.
